name: Elephant Rock Hotel
stayType: Small hotel in a Victorian terrace
accommodation: 18 bedrooms: singles, classic and superior doubles, executive sea-view rooms; family rooms on request
parking: Free on-site parking, including disabled spaces (tourism listing)
beachAccess: About 0.5 miles from East Strand, per tourism listing
confirmedFeatures: Breakfast included, 30-seat restaurant, cocktail bar and lounge with sea views, seasonal outdoor bar, robes and slippers, lift, Wi-Fi, step-free entrance, wheelchair-accessible bedroom
overview: Elephant Rock is an 18-bedroom hotel in a renovated Victorian terrace at Ramore Head in central Portrush, around half a mile from East Strand. Breakfast is included, and there is a restaurant, a sea-view cocktail bar and free on-site parking. Some rooms have sea views.
surfTripFit: Free parking is handy when you are loading boards, and East Strand and West Strand are both within walking distance.
